intro: Look-alike kanji almost always differ in one part, and that part carries meaning. Most kanji are built from a meaning part (the radical, usually on the left, top or outside) and a second part that often hints at the sound. When two kanji share the second part they often share the reading too (復・複・腹 are all ふく), so only the radical tells you which one you need. Do not try to remember the whole picture: find the one part that differs, and tie it to the meaning of the word.

skills.rule: Find the single part that differs and match it to the meaning: hand 扌 holds, road 彳 waits, an extra dot or line changes the word.
skills.explain:
待・持・特 share 寺 on the right; the left part decides. 彳 (a road) is 待つ まつ, to wait, as you wait by the road. 扌 (a hand) is 持つ もつ, to hold. 牛 (an ox) is 特 とく, special, as in 特別 and 特に.

Dots and short lines: 大 おお big; 太 ふと fat, thick, with a dot inside between the legs; 犬 いぬ dog, with a dot at the top right like an ear. 木 き tree; 本 ほん book, with a short line marking the root at the bottom. 千 せん thousand starts with a slanting stroke; 干す ほす, to dry, has a flat top. 土 つち earth has the long line at the bottom, like the ground; 士 し (a skilled man, as in 消防士) has the long line at the top.

右 みぎ: the slanting stroke pokes up through the horizontal (ナ over 口); 石 いし: a flat lid with the slanting stroke hanging below it. 人 ひと stands on a long left leg; in 入 はいる the right stroke is the long one and the short left stroke leans on its top, like an arrow going in.
patterns: 待 まつ (彳 road) / 持 もつ (扌 hand) / 特 とく (牛 ox)
大 big / 太 fat (dot inside) / 犬 dog (dot top right)
右 right (ナ + 口) / 石 stone (lid + 口)
木 tree / 本 book (line at the root)
人 person (long left leg) / 入 enter (long right stroke)
千 thousand (slanting top) / 干 dry (flat top)
土 earth (long bottom line) / 士 skilled man (long top line)

examples.jp: 駅[えき]で友達[ともだち]を{待[ま]って}います。
examples.en: I'm waiting for a friend at the station.

examples.jp: 傘[かさ]を{持[も]って}いますか。
examples.en: Do you have an umbrella with you?

examples.jp: 公園[こうえん]で{犬[いぬ]}が走[はし]っています。
examples.en: A dog is running in the park.

examples.jp: 次[つぎ]の角[かど]を{右[みぎ]}に曲[ま]がってください。
examples.en: Please turn right at the next corner.

examples.jp: 部屋[へや]に{入[はい]って}もいいですか。
examples.en: May I come into the room?

examples.jp: 今日[きょう]は{特別[とくべつ]}な日[ひ]です。
examples.en: Today is a special day.

contrast.note: Same right side 寺. Holding is done with the hand, so 持つ has 扌; waiting happens on the road, so 待つ has 彳.
Both are 大 plus a dot. Inside, between the legs, it is 太 (fat, thick); outside at the top right, like an ear, it is 犬 (dog).
人 is a person standing on a long left leg. 入 is the reverse: the right stroke is long and the short left stroke rests against its top.

mistakes.bad: 駅[えき]で友達[ともだち]を{持[ま]って}います。
mistakes.good: 駅[えき]で友達[ともだち]を{待[ま]って}います。
mistakes.note: You wait for a friend by the road (彳); 持 with the hand radical means to hold.

mistakes.bad: 図書館[としょかん]で{木[ほん]}を借[か]りました。
mistakes.good: 図書館[としょかん]で{本[ほん]}を借[か]りました。
mistakes.note: A book is 本, the tree with a line at its root; 木 alone is a tree.

mistakes.bad: ここから{人[はい]って}ください。
mistakes.good: ここから{入[はい]って}ください。
mistakes.note: To enter is 入, with the long stroke on the right; 人 is a person.

skills.tip: Say the meaning of the word, then look for the part that matches it: a hand for holding, a road for waiting, a root line for a book.

skills.rule: Under 貝 (money), the top part decides: a net 罒 buys, 代 lends, two axes make 質; for the other pairs, check whether a stroke pokes through or which line is longer.
skills.explain:
貝 is an old shell used as money. 買う かう, to buy, has a net 罒 on top: catch goods with money. 貸す かす, to lend, has 代 (in place of) on top: money that stands in for you. 質 しつ (質問, 品質) has two 斤 axes on top. Do not confuse 貸 with 貨 か (goods, 貨物): 貨 has 化 (亻 + 匕) on top, not 代 (亻 + 弋).

牛 うし, cow: the middle line pokes up through the top, like a horn. 午 ご, noon (午前, 午後): it stops at the top line.

鳥 とり, bird, ends in four dots (feet). 島 しま, island, replaces them with 山: a bird resting on a mountain in the sea.

末 すえ, end (週末), has the longer line on top: the branches have reached the end. 未 み, not yet (未来), has the shorter line on top: the tree has not grown yet.

白 しろ, white; 百 ひゃく, hundred, is 一 over 白; 自 じ, self (自分), is 目 with a stroke on top, so it has three boxes inside, not two. 休む やすむ, to rest, is a person 亻 by a tree 木; 体 からだ, body, is 亻 with 本.
patterns: 買 かう (罒 + 貝) / 貸 かす (代 + 貝) / 質 しつ (斤斤 + 貝) / 貨 か (化 + 貝)
牛 cow (pokes through) / 午 noon (stops)
鳥 bird (four dots) / 島 island (山)
末 end (long top line) / 未 not yet (short top line)
白 white / 百 hundred (一 + 白) / 自 self (two inner lines)
休 rest (亻 + 木) / 体 body (亻 + 本)

examples.jp: スーパーで野菜[やさい]を{買[か]いました}。
examples.en: I bought vegetables at the supermarket.

examples.jp: 友達[ともだち]に辞書[じしょ]を{貸[か]しました}。
examples.en: I lent my dictionary to a friend.

examples.jp: {午後[ごご]}三時[さんじ]に会[あ]いましょう。
examples.en: Let's meet at three in the afternoon.

examples.jp: 夏休[なつやす]みに{島[しま]}へ行[い]きました。
examples.en: I went to an island in the summer holidays.

examples.jp: 何[なに]か{質問[しつもん]}はありますか。
examples.en: Are there any questions?

examples.jp: 日曜日[にちようび]は家[いえ]で{休[やす]みます}。
examples.en: On Sundays I rest at home.

contrast.note: Both are read か and both sit on 貝. A net 罒 on top is buying (かう); 代 on top is lending (かす).
The cow's horn pokes up through the top line. Noon (午前, 午後) has no horn.
End has the long line on top (週末, 月末); not yet has the short line on top (未来, 未定).

mistakes.bad: スーパーで野菜[やさい]を{貸[か]いました}。
mistakes.good: スーパーで野菜[やさい]を{買[か]いました}。
mistakes.note: Buying is 買, with the net 罒 on top; 貸 is lending.

mistakes.bad: {牛後[ごご]}は会議[かいぎ]があります。
mistakes.good: {午後[ごご]}は会議[かいぎ]があります。
mistakes.note: Noon is 午: the middle stroke does not poke through the top.

mistakes.bad: 今月[こんげつ]の{未[すえ]}に引[ひ]っ越[こ]します。
mistakes.good: 今月[こんげつ]の{末[すえ]}に引[ひ]っ越[こ]します。
mistakes.note: The end of something is 末, with the long line on top.

skills.tip: Money word: look at the top of 貝. Otherwise ask one yes-or-no question: does a stroke poke through, or which line is longer?

skills.rule: 主, 辶 and 門 are shared frames; the part added to them gives the meaning: who lives, what pours, what goes in the gate.
skills.explain:
主 おも, main or master, is the base. Add a person 亻 and you get 住む すむ, to live (a person staying in place). Add water 氵 and you get 注 ちゅう, to pour or to pay attention (注意, 注文). Add the road 彳 and you get 往 おう, to go (往復, a round trip). 住 and 往 are the pair learners mix: person for living, road for going.

辶 is the walking radical; the part on it decides. 送る おくる, to send, has 关 (two dots over 天). 迷う まよう, to get lost, has 米, rice scattered in every direction. 逃げる にげる, to run away, has 兆.

門 is a gate, and the part inside tells what happens there. 開ける あける, open: hands lifting the bar 开. 閉める しめる, close: the bar 才 put in place. 間 あいだ or ま, between: the sun 日 shining through the gap. 聞く きく, hear: an ear 耳 at the gate. 問 もん, question (問題): a mouth 口 asking at the gate. 関 かん, connection or barrier (関係).
patterns: 主 main / 住 live (亻) / 注 pour, attention (氵) / 往 go (彳)
送 send (关) / 迷 get lost (米) / 逃 run away (兆)
門 + 开 開 open / 才 閉 close / 日 間 between / 耳 聞 hear / 口 問 ask / 关 関 connection

examples.jp: 東京[とうきょう]に{住[す]んで}います。
examples.en: I live in Tokyo.

examples.jp: 車[くるま]に{注意[ちゅうい]}してください。
examples.en: Please watch out for cars.

examples.jp: 母[はは]に荷物[にもつ]を{送[おく]りました}。
examples.en: I sent a parcel to my mother.

examples.jp: 駅[えき]までの道[みち]に{迷[まよ]って}しまいました。
examples.en: I got lost on the way to the station.

examples.jp: 窓[まど]を{開[あ]けて}もいいですか。
examples.en: May I open the window?

examples.jp: この{問題[もんだい]}は難[むずか]しいです。
examples.en: This problem is difficult.

contrast.note: Both are 主 with a left part. A person 亻 stays and lives (住む); the road 彳 goes (往復).
Both walk on 辶. Sending has 关 inside; getting lost has 米, rice scattered everywhere.
All are 門. Look inside: 开 opens, 才 closes, the sun 日 shows the gap between.

mistakes.bad: 大阪[おおさか]に{往[す]んで}います。
mistakes.good: 大阪[おおさか]に{住[す]んで}います。
mistakes.note: Living is what a person does: 住 has 亻. 往 with the road radical means to go.

mistakes.bad: 寒[さむ]いのでドアを{開[し]めて}ください。
mistakes.good: 寒[さむ]いのでドアを{閉[し]めて}ください。
mistakes.note: To close is 閉, the gate with the bar 才 inside; 開 opens it.

mistakes.bad: 山[やま]で道[みち]に{送[まよ]って}しまいました。
mistakes.good: 山[やま]で道[みち]に{迷[まよ]って}しまいました。
mistakes.note: Getting lost is 迷, with scattered rice 米; 送 means to send.

skills.tip: Same frame? Ignore it and read only the added part: who or what is inside the gate, on the road, or next to 主.

skills.rule: In each set all the kanji share the sound, so the radical decides: road 彳, clothes 衤, body 月; horse 馬, tree 木, hill 阝; thread 糸, grain 禾; road 辶, strike 攵, water 氵.
skills.explain:
These four sets are the classic trap: every member is read the same, so you cannot pick by sound.

ふく: 復 has the road 彳, going back over the same way: 復習 (review), 往復, 回復. 複 has the clothes radical 衤, layers of cloth: 複雑 (complicated), 複数 (several). 腹 has 月, the body (flesh) radical: お腹 おなか, 腹痛.

けん: 験 has 馬, a horse being tested: 試験, 経験, 実験. 検 has 木, a wooden tally used to check: 検査, 点検. 険 has 阝, a steep hill: 危険, 保険, 冒険.

せき: 績 has 糸, thread spun into a finished result: 成績 (grades), 業績. 積 has 禾, grain piled up: 積む つむ, 面積, 積極的. 責 is the bare base with nothing on the left: 責任 (responsibility). 成績 written as 成積 is one of the commonest errors even among native writers.

てき: 適 has 辶, the road that fits: 適当, 適切. 敵 has 攵, a hand striking: 敵, the enemy. 滴 has 氵, water: 水滴, 一滴, a drop.
patterns: ふく: 復 (彳 go back) / 複 (衤 layers) / 腹 (月 belly)
けん: 験 (馬 test) / 検 (木 inspect) / 険 (阝 steep, danger)
せき: 績 (糸 result) / 積 (禾 pile up) / 責 (responsibility)
てき: 適 (辶 suitable) / 敵 (攵 enemy) / 滴 (氵 drop)

examples.jp: 毎晩[まいばん]、その日[ひ]の授業[じゅぎょう]を{復習[ふくしゅう]}しています。
examples.en: Every evening I review that day's lessons.

examples.jp: この問題[もんだい]は思[おも]ったより{複雑[ふくざつ]}です。
examples.en: This problem is more complicated than I thought.

examples.jp: 来週[らいしゅう]、大切[たいせつ]な{試験[しけん]}があります。
examples.en: I have an important exam next week.

examples.jp: この川[かわ]で泳[およ]ぐのは{危険[きけん]}です。
examples.en: It is dangerous to swim in this river.

examples.jp: 今学期[こんがっき]は{成績[せいせき]}が上[あ]がりました。
examples.en: My grades went up this term.

examples.jp: {適切[てきせつ]}な言葉[ことば]を選[えら]んでください。
examples.en: Please choose appropriate words.

contrast.note: All ふく. Going back over something (review, round trip, recovery) is 復; layers and plurality are 複; the belly is 腹.
All けん. Trying something out (exam, experience, experiment) is 験; checking and inspecting is 検; danger and insurance are 険.
Both せき. A finished result (grades, achievements) is 績 with 糸; piling up, area and being active are 積 with 禾.

mistakes.bad: 家[いえ]で{腹習[ふくしゅう]}しました。
mistakes.good: 家[いえ]で{復習[ふくしゅう]}しました。
mistakes.note: Review means going back over a lesson: 復 with the road radical. 腹 is the belly.

mistakes.bad: 夜[よる]の山道[やまみち]は{危験[きけん]}です。
mistakes.good: 夜[よる]の山道[やまみち]は{危険[きけん]}です。
mistakes.note: Danger is 険, the steep hill 阝. 験 with the horse is for tests and experience.

mistakes.bad: {成積[せいせき]}が良[よ]くなりました。
mistakes.good: {成績[せいせき]}が良[よ]くなりました。
mistakes.note: Grades are a finished result, 績 with thread 糸. 積 with grain means to pile up.

skills.tip: Same sound means the sound will not help: say what the word is about (road, body, horse, hill, thread, grain, water) and pick that radical.

skills.rule: Find the one stroke group that differs and give it a meaning: the king in 徴, metal in 録, the extra line of 幸, the tree in 困, the bottom part under 莫.
skills.explain:
微 び, slight (微妙, 微笑む ほほえむ), and 徴 ちょう, sign (特徴, 象徴), differ only in the middle bottom: 微 has a small 几, 徴 has 王, a king, whose mark distinguishes him.

录 on the right: with thread 糸 it is 緑 みどり, green; with metal 金 it is 録 ろく, record (記録, 録音), sound cut into metal. 縁 えん, bond or edge, also has 糸 but a different right side, 彖, ending like 豕.

幸 しあわせ, happiness, is 辛 からい or つらい, spicy or hard, plus one more line: add one line to hardship and you get happiness.

In a box 口: a tree 木 is stuck and cannot grow, 困る こまる, to be in trouble; 大 inside is 因 いん, cause (原因).

輸 ゆ (輸入, 輸出) and 輪 わ or りん (指輪, 車輪) both have 車. 輸 ends in 月 and 刂 (carrying goods); 輪 ends in 冊, like the spokes of a wheel.

莫 on top, the bottom decides: 土 earth 墓 はか, grave; 日 sun 暮らす くらす, to live, and 暮れる, to get dark; 力 strength 募集 ぼしゅう, to recruit; 巾 cloth 幕 まく, curtain.
patterns: 微 slight (几) / 徴 sign (王)
緑 green (糸 + 录) / 録 record (金 + 录) / 縁 bond, edge (糸 + 彖)
辛 spicy, hard / 幸 happiness (one more line)
困 trouble (木 in a box) / 因 cause (大 in a box)
輸 transport (月 + 刂) / 輪 ring, wheel (冊)
莫 + 土 墓 grave / 日 暮 live / 力 募 recruit / 巾 幕 curtain

examples.jp: 春[はる]になると山[やま]が{緑[みどり]}になります。
examples.en: In spring the mountains turn green.

examples.jp: 会議[かいぎ]の内容[ないよう]を{記録[きろく]}してください。
examples.en: Please keep a record of the meeting.

examples.jp: このカレーは少[すこ]し{辛[から]い}です。
examples.en: This curry is a little spicy.

examples.jp: 警察[けいさつ]が事故[じこ]の{原因[げんいん]}を調[しら]べています。
examples.en: The police are investigating the cause of the accident.

examples.jp: 日本[にほん]は多[おお]くの食料[しょくりょう]を{輸入[ゆにゅう]}しています。
examples.en: Japan imports a lot of its food.

examples.jp: 祖父[そふ]は田舎[いなか]で静[しず]かに{暮[く]らして}います。
examples.en: My grandfather lives quietly in the countryside.

contrast.note: 幸 has four horizontal lines, 辛 only three (with a dot on top). Happiness has the extra one.
Both are a box. A tree 木 trapped inside is trouble (困る); 大 inside is a cause (原因).

contrast.vs: 墓 / 暮 / 募 / 幕
contrast.note: All share 莫. Earth below is a grave, the sun below is daily life and dusk, strength below is recruiting, cloth below is a curtain.

mistakes.bad: この犬[いぬ]は耳[みみ]が大[おお]きいのが{特微[とくちょう]}です。
mistakes.good: この犬[いぬ]は耳[みみ]が大[おお]きいのが{特徴[とくちょう]}です。
mistakes.note: A distinguishing feature is 特徴, with the king 王 in the middle; 微 means slight.

mistakes.bad: このラーメンは{幸[から]い}です。
mistakes.good: このラーメンは{辛[から]い}です。
mistakes.note: Spicy is 辛, the one with one line fewer; 幸 is happiness.

mistakes.bad: 石油[せきゆ]を{輪入[ゆにゅう]}しています。
mistakes.good: 石油[せきゆ]を{輸入[ゆにゅう]}しています。
mistakes.note: Importing is 輸, carrying goods; 輪 is a ring or wheel.

skills.tip: Cover the shared part with your thumb and look at what is left: that small piece is the whole difference.
